تعتزلين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَزِلِينَ (taʕtazilīna) /taʕ.ta.zi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# تُعْتَزَلِينَ (tuʕtazalīna) /tuʕ.ta.za.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
